UKB-PPP is cited to entry 19 (Sun 2023), a source with several dictionary rows; the only attribute given (54,219 plasma samples, 2923 proteins, Olink) is no row's N and separates none of them (rule E not met).

rows.quote: The deCODE Health study measured 4907 proteins in the plasma of 35,559 Icelanders using the SomaScan platform and found 18,084 correlated sequence variants between plasma protein levels.
